data.name: CarbonRun
data.description: CarbonRun is a Nova Scotia-based CDR startup founded in 2022 that deploys river alkalinity enhancement (RAE) — adding finely crushed limestone to acidified rivers to neutralize acid-rain damage while converting CO2 into bicarbonate that is transported to the ocean for long-term storage. The company operates the world's first full-scale RAE project on the West River in Pictou County and signed a $25.4M / 55,000-tonne offtake with Frontier in September 2024, with Isometric certifying the first RAE protocol in 2025.
